title: Great Value Organic Triple Berry Blend 10 OZ
product: Great Value Organic Triple Berry Blend 10 OZ (Including Strawberries, Blackberries and Blueberries)
company: Frutas y Hortalizas del Sur S.A.
distribution: Shipped to select Walmart stores in Alabama, Arkansas, Florida, Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Louisiana, Minnesota, Mississippi, Missouri, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, South Carolina, Texas and Wisconsin.
source: FDA recall announcement / SAFEPLATE normalized record
summary: Potential contamination with Escherichia coli O145:H28 (E. coli O145).

evidence.text: Frutas y Hortalizas del Sur S.A. expanded a recall to include one lot of Great Value Organic Triple Berry Blend because of potential E. coli O145:H28 contamination.
UPC 7874211226; Lot Code 6040 01-6; Best If Used By February 9, 2028
Shipped to select Walmart stores in 16 states.
Frutas y Hortalizas del Sur S.A., San Carlos, Chile
